award.reason: Germie Bernard scored 20.2 on a 8.13 projection, 12.07 over, in a 5.34-point win after a recent roster move.

matchups.recap: Lil Fridge flattened Brock ‘N’ Roll 126.79 to 88.31, and at least namesake Brock Purdy finished as the losing side's top scorer. Recent adds Dallas Goedert and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers chipped in 9.1 and 9.65 for the losers, while the new pickup on the other side, the Denver Broncos, outscored both of them. Davante Adams and Mike Evans are now listed Out, and Romeo Doubs is now listed IR.

Return of T Mac flattened Unsolicited Dak Picks 120.29 to 81.47 in an upset, a season low for the losing side. Carnell Tate, the new pickup by trade, posted 16, while waiver add Kimani Vidal managed 5.5 on the other side. Juwan Johnson put up a goose egg at tight end, and A.J. Brown, now listed Questionable, wasn't much better.

Maye d'force B with U beat Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team by 9.51, and Isaiah Likely won it from tight end, outscoring the margin on his own with 20.9. The trade haul for this 4-8 side brought in recent add Bhayshul Tuten, who put up 22.7, and also Garrett Wilson, who did not. Dalton Kincaid, another trade pickup, is now listed Questionable, and so is Jaylen Waddle on the winning side.

Bo Girds starters dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, and those drops cost them the game. Losing to a side that sat 11th before the week makes it an upset, and the Colts defense, a recent add, chipped in -0.85 for the privilege. Bold free agency strategy.

London Cooking flattened To Infinity and Bijan 112.48 to 46.08, a season low for the losing side. The namesake Bijan Robinson scored 6.3, and Rhamondre Stevenson, a recent add by trade, chipped in 3.6. That same trade-happy roster also holds recent adds Ladd McConkey and Terry McLaurin, both now listed Out.

All You Need Is Love handled Pukancun on 3 by 12.95, and Tre Tucker won it on his own with 24.2. Cam Skattebo, a recent add by trade, returned a flat 0 for a side now sitting at 1-11. Great trade, truly.

blurbs.motw: behold the lamb beat Bo Girds 114.95 to 109.61 in an upset. Germie Bernard, a recent add off waivers, won it with 20.2 on an 8.13 projection. The other side's starters dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, and those drops cost the game. Matthew Golden owned 3 of those drops, worth about 14.2 on his own. Then the Indianapolis Colts defense, their own recent add, blew it at -0.85. Awful pickup.
blurbs.game_changer: Germie Bernard, the new pickup off waivers in week 5, turned an 8.13 projection into 20.2 and takes the Game Changer. He has now beaten projection in 3 of the last 3 weeks. The waiver wire delivers. Everyone beheld the wrong Lamb, too: CeeDee Lamb managed 11.5 for behold the lamb while Germie topped the roster. Without Bernard, that is a loss to Bo Girds instead of an upset by a side that sat 11th before the week.
blurbs.awards: To Infinity and Bijan got 6.3 points from Bijan Robinson on a 23.08 projection, good for Underperformer. Not quite infinity. Bhayshul Tuten, a recent add by trade, took Lucky with 22.7 on 12.49 expected points. London Cooking left Jayden Daniels and his 21 points on the bench, the most of any bench player and good for MVB.
blurbs.position_leaders: Bo Girds showed up twice, with Kenneth Walker leading all running backs at 26.9 and Tyler Shough finishing 2nd among quarterbacks. Trevor Lawrence still topped every quarterback with 28.34 for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team. The force was with Maye d'force B with U, as Drake Maye and Isaiah Likely both made the podium at their positions. Tre Tucker topped all receivers on a WOPR that ranked just 26th, so All You Need Is Love apparently needs very few targets.
